bad_box.description: Accumulated failures. Check before trying something new.
bad_box.expectation: Each entry: timestamp, what_failed, why, do_not (anti-pattern), context.
patterns: Do not accept unverified receipts as authority
Do not assume null/empty/massive inputs are handled
Do not trust single-source results without cross-reference
Do not embed full Page 0 text

data_expectations._honesty_note: Most of these do not exist yet. Marked as CURRENT vs PLANNED.

embeddings.expectation: Vector representations. Must include model ID and version.

evolution_logs.expectation: Append-only. Each entry: timestamp, test ID, pass/fail, pattern classification.

processed_data.expectation: Derived from raw. Must reference source hash. Reproducible.

raw_dogfood.expectation: Immutable input logs. Content-addressed by SHA-256. Never mutated.

registry_scoring.expectation: Scores must be reproducible from same inputs.

stable_paths.expectation: Absolute paths only. No relative path drift. Mount point must be stable across reboots.

versioning.expectation: Git commits for code. Append-only JSONL for logs. Blueprint revisions increment on every change.

forward_observer_constraints.blocking: Non-blocking. Wrong predictions = wasted compute, not wrong results.
forward_observer_constraints.status: Partially implemented (predictForwardErrors in Expedition). Full Forward Observer as code not yet built.
forward_observer_constraints.stopping_rule: Stop when guessing begins. Say 'I don't know.'

good_box.description: Verified reusable machinery. Use before inventing.
good_box.expectation: Every verified capability should have: id, provides[], verification evidence, reuse count.

M1_immutable_evaluation.what: Deep-frozen evaluation contract. Later success cannot redefine success.

M2_composition_first.what: What percentage of solution already exists in composable form?

M3_failure_capitalization.what: Failure → signature → detector → fixture → regression test → repair pattern.

M4_bidirectional_replay.what: Backward protects intent. Forward protects consequences.

M5_question_economy.what: Information unlocked / owner interruption. Must collapse >10% of possibilities.

M8_authority_creativity.what: Narrow authority creates safe basin for extreme creativity.

M9_least_resistance.what: Intelligence in topology, not instructions. 8 automatic mechanisms.

authority_rules: Share information aggressively. Share authority reluctantly.
page0_frozen_contract.core_law: NO CLAIM MAY HAVE HIGHER STATUS THAN STRONGEST INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE.
page0_frozen_contract.foundational_inversion: The model stopped being the authority that decides what the user meant.

recursive_grammar.description: Every funnel run passes through 7 locked stages. Each stage has pre/post conditions. Receipt minted only if all stages valid.

ssd_design_constraints.2_content_addressed: Raw data addressed by hash, not just filename.
ssd_design_constraints.3_append_only_logs: Evolution logs and anti-intent are append-only.
ssd_design_constraints.4_separate_current_planned: Don't mix implemented systems with aspirational ones in the same tree without labeling.
ssd_design_constraints.5_absolute_paths: All funnel code references absolute paths.
ssd_design_constraints.6_no_authority_escalation: Data on SSD does not grant authority. Only kernel receipts do.
